notes: 英文是在遊戲外執行模組註冊文字的程式（Tokens.AddTokens）取得的，技能傷害與數值是模組設定的預設值；改過設定的話，譯文的數字要自己修改。

BOG_SQUALL_BODY_PICKUP.zh-TW: 探路者忠誠的機械獵鷹。

BOG_SQUALL_BODY_DESCRIPTION.en: A robotic falcon that accompanies the Pathfinder. Squall inherits most of the Pathfinder's items, and <style=cIsUtility>cannot be destroyed</style>.
BOG_SQUALL_BODY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 陪伴探路者的機械獵鷹。疾風會繼承探路者大部分的物品，而且<style=cIsUtility>不會被摧毀</style>。

BOG_SQUALL_BODY_SKILL_DESCRIPTION.en: Fires mounted guns and missiles at enemies while in <color=#FF0000>Attack Mode</color>, and repeatedly strikes targets when ordered to <style=cIsDamage>Go for the Throat</style>.
BOG_SQUALL_BODY_SKILL_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 處於<color=#FF0000>攻擊模式</color>時，會用搭載的機槍與導彈攻擊敵人；收到<style=cIsDamage>直取咽喉</style>的命令時，會反覆攻擊目標。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_DESCRIPTION.en:
The Pathfinder is a crafty, evasive skirmisher who fights alongside his trusty falcon, Squall.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > You are quite fragile compared to other melee survivors; use your quick feet, long reach, and Squall's distractions to stay alive.

< ! > Alternate between Fleetfoot and your javelin toss to throw as many javelins as possible, but make sure to reserve a skill charge to dodge when necessary.

< ! > Shock Bolas are a great way to lock down large groups of enemies at once, while Rending Talons can deal brutal damage when combined with items that increase your air time.

< ! > Squall is a highly capable fighter; command him liberally and prioritize attack speed and critical chance items to help speed up the battery meter.


<style=cShrine>Modder's Note:</style> <style=cUserSetting>Thank you so much for showing interest in <color=#3ea252>The Pathfinder</color>! For feedback and bug reports, please contact <style=cIsUtility>bog_rtm</style> on Discord, or post an issue on the github repo.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
探路者是一名狡黠、善於閃避的遊擊戰士，與他可靠的獵鷹疾風並肩作戰。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! >與其他近戰倖存者相比，你相當脆弱；善用你敏捷的步伐、長距離的攻擊範圍，以及疾風的牽制來保住性命。

< ! >交替使用迅足與擲出標槍，盡可能多擲出標槍，但務必保留一次技能充能，以便在必要時閃避。

< ! >電擊流星索非常適合一次控制住大群敵人，而撕裂鷹爪搭配能延長滯空時間的物品，可以造成驚人的傷害。

< ! >疾風是非常能幹的戰士；儘管多對他下達指令，並優先選擇攻擊速度與暴擊機率類的物品，以加快電池量表的回復。


<style=cShrine>模組作者的話：</style><style=cUserSetting>非常感謝你對<color=#3ea252>探路者</color>感興趣！如有意見回饋或錯誤回報，請在Discord上聯絡<style=cIsUtility>bog_rtm</style>，或到GitHub儲存庫提交問題回報。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_LORE.en: "You bloody idiot, that's not a Red Snubtail, that's a Rosy Quillback rat! You caught the wrong rodent." "So what? It's got red fur and a stubby tail, I say we just take it and finish the job." "We've been over this; snubtails mimic quillbacks to deter predators, so you have to check their fur for tiny spines. Also, quillbacks are strict insectivores; that's why I told you not to use the live insect bait, so you wouldn't accidentally attract one. Did you even read the bestiary entries that I showed you?" "So it's got some puny needles on its arse, big deal. We've been chasing after a damn rat for three days now. Besides, our client's just some rich snob looking for a fancy exotic pet to show off in front of their other rich snob friends; they'll never tell the difference. This one's just a tiny bit prickly, they won't mind." "Did you forget that quillbacks are poisonous, genius? They'll damn well be able to tell the bloody difference when they pet the bugger, then wake up the next morning, paralyzed head to toe. Do you want to earn us a manslaughter charge, you mongrel?" "They're poisonous?" "................... Where are your gloves?" "..." "I'm finding a new partner."
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_LORE.zh-TW: 「你這該死的白痴，那不是紅鈍尾鼠，那是玫瑰刺背鼠！你抓錯老鼠了。」 「那又怎樣？牠一樣是紅毛、短尾巴，要我說，直接把牠帶走，把工作做完就好。」 「這我們講過了：鈍尾鼠會模仿刺背鼠來嚇阻掠食者，所以你得檢查牠們的毛裡有沒有細小的刺。還有，刺背鼠是嚴格的食蟲動物，所以我才叫你別用活蟲當誘餌，免得不小心引來一隻。我給你看的那些生物圖鑑條目，你到底有沒有讀？」 「所以牠屁股上長了幾根小針，有什麼大不了的。我們追一隻該死的老鼠已經追了三天了。再說，我們的客戶不過是個有錢的勢利鬼，想找隻花俏的異國寵物，在其他有錢的勢利鬼朋友面前炫耀；他們根本分不出差別。這隻只是稍微扎手一點，他們不會在意的。」 「你忘了刺背鼠是有毒的嗎，天才？等他們摸了那隻小混蛋，隔天早上醒來從頭到腳都癱瘓了，他們他媽的絕對分得出差別。你是想害我們背上過失殺人罪嗎，你這雜種？」 「牠們有毒？」 「…………………………你的手套呢？」 「……」 「我要去找新搭檔了。」

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_OUTRO_FLAVOR.en: ..and so they left, as the new kings of the food chain.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_OUTRO_FLAVOR.zh-TW: ……於是他們走了，成為食物鏈的新王者。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_OUTRO_FAILURE.en: ..and so they vanished, forever lost to the uncaring wilderness.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_OUTRO_FAILURE.zh-TW: ……於是他們就這樣消逝了，永遠迷失在冷漠無情的荒野之中。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: You are accompanied by your robot falcon, Squall. Squall inherits <style=cIsDamage>most</style> of your items and is immune to damage, but runs on a <style=cIsUtility>battery</style>.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 你的機械獵鷹疾風會與你同行。疾風會繼承你<style=cIsDamage>大部分</style>的物品，且不會受到傷害，但要靠<style=cIsUtility>電池</style>運作。

KEYWORD_BATTERY.en: <style=cKeywordName>Battery</style><style=cSub>Squall has two modes: <color=#FF0000>Attack</color>, and <color=#00FF00>Follow</color>. In <color=#FF0000>Attack Mode</color>, Squall rapidly <style=cIsDamage>drains</style> battery. In <color=#00FF00>Follow Mode</color>, Squall <style=cIsHealing>regenerates</style> battery at a rate proportional with <style=cIsUtility>his attack speed.</style>
KEYWORD_BATTERY.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>電池</style><style=cSub>疾風有兩種模式：<color=#FF0000>攻擊</color>與<color=#00FF00>跟隨</color>。在<color=#FF0000>攻擊模式</color>下，疾風會快速<style=cIsDamage>消耗</style>電池電量。在<color=#00FF00>跟隨模式</color>下，疾風會<style=cIsHealing>回復</style>電池電量，速度與<style=cIsUtility>他的攻擊速度成正比。</style>

KEYWORD_PIERCE.en: <style=cKeywordName>Piercing</style><style=cSub>Striking with the <style=cIsUtility>tip</style> deals <style=cIsDamage>325% damage</style> and <style=cIsDamage>bypasses armor</style> instead.</style>
KEYWORD_PIERCE.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>穿刺</style><style=cSub>以<style=cIsUtility>矛尖</style>命中時，改為造成<style=cIsDamage>325%傷害</style>並<style=cIsDamage>無視護甲</style>。</style>

KEYWORD_ELECTROCUTE.en: <style=cKeywordName>Electrocute</style><style=cSub>Targets have their movespeed reduced by 50%, and take <style=cIsDamage>120% damage</style> per second.</style>
KEYWORD_ELECTROCUTE.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>電擊</style><style=cSub>目標的移動速度降低50%，且每秒受到<style=cIsDamage>120%傷害</style>。</style>

KEYWORD_ATTACK.en: <style=cKeywordName><color=#FF0000>Attack</color></style><style=cSub>Direct Squall's attention to the targeted enemy, and activate <color=#FF0000>Attack Mode</color>, granting access to machine guns that deal <style=cIsDamage>2x30% damage</style>, and a missile launcher that deals <style=cIsDamage>150% damage</style>.</style>
KEYWORD_ATTACK.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName><color=#FF0000>攻擊</color></style><style=cSub>讓疾風鎖定瞄準的敵人，並啟動<color=#FF0000>攻擊模式</color>，使其能使用造成<style=cIsDamage>2x30%傷害</style>的機槍，以及造成<style=cIsDamage>150%傷害</style>的導彈發射器。</style>

KEYWORD_FOLLOW.en: <style=cKeywordName><color=#00FF00>Follow</color></style><style=cSub>Return Squall to yourself, and activate <color=#00FF00>Follow Mode</color>, causing him to stay close to you.</style>
KEYWORD_FOLLOW.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName><color=#00FF00>跟隨</color></style><style=cSub>召回疾風，並啟動<color=#00FF00>跟隨模式</color>，讓他待在你身邊。</style>

KEYWORD_SQUALL_SPECIAL.en: <style=cKeywordName><color=#efeb1c>Special - Go for the Throat!</color></style><style=cSub>Order Squall to repeatedly strike the targeted enemy for <style=cIsDamage>70% damage</style>. Each strike briefly shreds <style=cIsDamage>armor</style>, and <style=cIsUtility>regenerates 1%</style> battery, doubled on Critical Strikes. This skill can briefly <style=cIsUtility>overcharge</style> the battery.</style>
KEYWORD_SQUALL_SPECIAL.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName><color=#efeb1c>特殊：直取咽喉！</color></style><style=cSub>命令疾風反覆攻擊瞄準的敵人，造成<style=cIsDamage>70%傷害</style>。每次攻擊都會短暫削減<style=cIsDamage>護甲</style>，並<style=cIsUtility>回復1%</style>電池電量，暴擊時加倍。此技能可讓電池短暫<style=cIsUtility>超量充電</style>。</style>

KEYWORD_UNPOLISHED.en: <style=cKeywordName>Unpolished</style> <style=cSub>This skill is missing VFX and SFX, and is also probably buggier than the others.
KEYWORD_UNPOLISHED.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>未完善</style> <style=cSub>這個技能缺少視覺特效與音效，而且大概也比其他技能更容易出錯。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_PRIMARY_THRUST_DESCR.en: <style=cIsUtility>Piercing</style>. Thrust your spear forward for <style=cIsDamage>250% damage</style>.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_PRIMARY_THRUST_DESCR.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>穿刺</style>。將長矛向前刺出，造成<style=cIsDamage>250%傷害</style>。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SECONDARY_DASH_DESCR.en: <style=cIsUtility>Dash</style> a short distance. The next time you use your primary skill, throw an <style=cIsDamage>explosive</style> javelin for <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style>.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SECONDARY_DASH_DESCR.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>衝刺</style>一小段距離。下一次使用主要技能時，會擲出一支<style=cIsDamage>爆裂</style>標槍，造成<style=cIsDamage>800%傷害</style>。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SECONDARY_JAVELIN_DE.zh-TW: 擲出一支<style=cIsDamage>爆裂</style>標槍，造成<style=cIsDamage>800%傷害</style>。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_UTILITY_SPIN_DESCRIP.en: Rise into the air, spinning rapidly for <style=cIsDamage>300% damage</style>. Upon landing, perform a horizontal sweep for <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style>.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_UTILITY_SPIN_DESCRIP.zh-TW: 升上空中並快速旋轉，造成<style=cIsDamage>300%傷害</style>。落地時進行一次水平橫掃，造成<style=cIsDamage>800%傷害</style>。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_UTILITY_BOLAS_DESCRI.en: Throw electrically charged bolas, which <style=cIsUtility>shock</style> nearby enemies, and leave behind an <style=cIsUtility>electrocuting</style> field for <style=cIsUtility>10 seconds</style>.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_UTILITY_BOLAS_DESCRI.zh-TW: 擲出帶電的流星索，<style=cIsUtility>震盪</style>附近的敵人，並留下持續<style=cIsUtility>10秒</style>的<style=cIsUtility>電擊</style>力場。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_COMMAND2_NAM.zh-TW: 下達指令：輔助技能覆寫

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_COMMAND_DESC.en: Prepare a command for Squall. You can issue an <color=#FF0000>Attack</color>, <color=#00FF00>Follow</color>, or <color=#efeb1c>Special</color> command by pressing the Primary, Secondary, or Special skill keys, respectively.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_COMMAND_DESC.zh-TW: 準備向疾風下達指令。分別按下主要技能、次要技能或特殊技能鍵，即可下達<color=#FF0000>攻擊</color>、<color=#00FF00>跟隨</color>或<color=#efeb1c>特殊</color>指令。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_ATTACK_DESCR.en: Direct Squall's attention to the targeted enemy, and activate <color=#FF0000>Attack Mode</color>, granting access to machine guns that deal <style=cIsDamage>2x30% damage</style>, and a missile launcher that deals <style=cIsDamage>150% damage</style>.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_ATTACK_DESCR.zh-TW: 讓疾風鎖定瞄準的敵人，並啟動<color=#FF0000>攻擊模式</color>，使其能使用造成<style=cIsDamage>2x30%傷害</style>的機槍，以及造成<style=cIsDamage>150%傷害</style>的導彈發射器。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_FOLLOW_DESCR.en: Return Squall to yourself, and activate <color=#00FF00>Follow Mode</color>, causing him to stay close to you.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_SPECIAL_FOLLOW_DESCR.zh-TW: 召回疾風，並啟動<color=#00FF00>跟隨模式</color>，讓他待在你身邊。

BOGSQUALL_SPECIAL_GOFORTHROAT_DESCRIPTIO.en: Order Squall to repeatedly strike the targeted enemy for <style=cIsDamage>70% damage</style>. Each strike briefly shreds <style=cIsDamage>armor</style>, and <style=cIsUtility>regenerates 1%</style> battery, doubled on Critical Strikes. This skill can briefly <style=cIsUtility>overcharge</style> the battery.
BOGSQUALL_SPECIAL_GOFORTHROAT_DESCRIPTIO.zh-TW: 命令疾風反覆攻擊瞄準的敵人，造成<style=cIsDamage>70%傷害</style>。每次攻擊都會短暫削減<style=cIsDamage>護甲</style>，並<style=cIsUtility>回復1%</style>電池電量，暴擊時加倍。此技能可讓電池短暫<style=cIsUtility>超量充電</style>。

BOG_SQUALL_SECONDARY_MISSILE_DESCRIPTION.en: Fire a volley of 4 missiles for <style=cIsDamage>150% damage</style> each.

BOG_SQUALL_UTILITY_DONOTHING_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 這個技能沒有任何作用。

BOG_SQUALL_SPECIAL_GOFORTHROAT_DESCRIPTI.en: Order Squall to repeatedly strike the targeted enemy for <style=cIsDamage>70% damage</style>. Each strike briefly shreds <style=cIsDamage>armor</style>, and <style=cIsUtility>regenerates 1%</style> battery, doubled on Critical Strikes. This skill can briefly <style=cIsUtility>overcharge</style> the battery.
BOG_SQUALL_SPECIAL_GOFORTHROAT_DESCRIPTI.zh-TW: 命令疾風反覆攻擊瞄準的敵人，造成<style=cIsDamage>70%傷害</style>。每次攻擊都會短暫削減<style=cIsDamage>護甲</style>，並<style=cIsUtility>回復1%</style>電池電量，暴擊時加倍。此技能可讓電池短暫<style=cIsUtility>超量充電</style>。

BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_MASTERYUNLOCKABLE_AC.en: As Pathfinder, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
BOG_PATHFINDER_BODY_MASTERYUNLOCKABLE_AC.zh-TW: 作為探路者，在季風難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。
